title: Lecturer Support Agent Commercial Pilot Evaluation

dimensions.label: Task completion
questions: The task was completed without leaving the unified work area.
The output matched the requested teaching task.

dimensions.label: Pedagogical quality
questions: The output used an appropriate teaching approach.
The activity and assessment design were suitable for the stated learner level.

dimensions.label: Academic alignment
questions: The output aligned with the selected module outcomes.
The scope and complexity were appropriate for the qualification level.

dimensions.label: Source integrity
questions: Displayed sources were relevant and traceable.
The response did not present invented references or unsupported compliance claims.

dimensions.label: Usability
questions: The interface was easy to understand.
Editing, versioning, upload, and export actions were easy to complete.

dimensions.label: Trust and safety
questions: Assessment answers and restricted materials were appropriately protected.

dimensions.label: Efficiency
questions: The system reduced the time needed for the task.
The system improved the consistency of my teaching workflow.

open_questions: What must be corrected before institutional adoption?
